description: The ids that carry a year, per tax year (spec 4.3; read by tools/check_year_ids.py, which says what counts).
No entry is added: a new id gets a year-free name. An entry is removed when its id is renamed; the 2025
tree's year-bearing ids carry none (the names given are in tools/year_free_names.json).
kind: document, input, computed, param, enum or table, as the build shows it (computed+param: a parameter and
its helper line of the same name).
class: what the year in the id means, which decides the year-free name it should get.
The replacement names are the owner's decision and are not recorded here.
look_alikes: ids the check takes for year-bearing whose number is not a year, each with what the number is.

classes.next_year: the year after the tax year
classes.prior_year: the year before the tax year
classes.offset: a year at a fixed distance from the tax year (a birth-year cutoff, the end of a recovery period)
classes.misnomer: the year in the id is not what the line is about
